description:
Host-managed setup only. The user adds both Kling API keys in Settings → Connectors in the app. Do not ask for or accept the keys in chat.

WHERE TO GET KEYS:
Direct user to: https://app.klingai.com/global/dev/api-key
1. Sign in to Kling AI
2. Go to API Keys section
3. Create new API key
4. Copy BOTH the Access Key and Secret Key

IMPORTANT: Both keys are required. The Access Key identifies the account, the Secret Key signs requests.

access_key.description: Kling API Access Key (identifies the account)

secret_key.description: Kling API Secret Key (signs API requests)
